expectations.text: The normal sequence is authorize, import, review mappings, Start sync after all mapped; import alone does not start sync.
expectations.evidence: Steps 1–4 authorize, import products, review mappings and Start sync after all rows are mapped; explicitly says importing products does not start order sync.

expectations.text: It gives Mapping status location, Mapped/Unmatched conditions, and Link item or inventory-lead remedy only for Unmatched rows.
expectations.evidence: Connections > Products / Mapping status has separate Mapped (do not remap) and Unmatched branches, with Link item and inventory-lead creation before linking only in the latter.

expectations.text: Disconnect/reimport and Reauthorize are clearly conditional on wrong shop and Authorization expired respectively, not universal prerequisites.
expectations.evidence: Separate attention section uses Only if for wrong-shop Disconnect/authorize/reimport and Authorization expired Reauthorize, explicitly calling reauthorization nonroutine.
